music_stack.hook: From a single prompt to a finished, mastered track — what does the pipeline do?
music_stack.recall: What does an AI music pipeline do?
music_stack.answer: prompt/lyrics -> generate audio -> mix -> master -> a finished track

prompt_to_music.hook: Vague prompt = generic track. How do you steer the model?
prompt_to_music.recall: How do you steer an AI music model?
prompt_to_music.answer: a prompt describing style/genre/mood/instruments/BPM (+ optional lyrics)

lyrics_to_song.hook: You wrote lyrics. How do they become an actually-sung track?
lyrics_to_song.recall: How do you turn your lyrics into a sung song?
lyrics_to_song.answer: feed lyrics + a style to a vocal-capable model (e.g. ACE-Step) and it sings them

music_styles.hook: One engine, many genres. Name a few you can make.
music_styles.answer: songs, beats, lofi, ambient, focus/study, 432Hz meditation, ghazal

ai_singer.hook: Want one consistent voice across all your tracks? Build your own ___.
ai_singer.recall: How do you build your own AI singer?
ai_singer.answer: voice conversion (RVC) — train a voice model and apply it to the generated vocals

mixing.hook: All the parts exist but it sounds muddy. What step fixes the balance?
mixing.answer: balancing levels / EQ / panning of the parts into one coherent track

mastering.hook: Your track is quiet next to Spotify songs. What's the final polish?
mastering.answer: final loudness / EQ / limiting so it sounds pro + consistent across devices

focus_audio.hook: Focus + meditation music hides a trick beat under the melody. What?
focus_audio.recall: What are isochronic / binaural tones for?
focus_audio.answer: rhythmic tones (beta/alpha/theta) layered in to aid focus or relaxation

copyright_clean_music.hook: You want to monetize every track with zero takedown risk. What makes that safe?
copyright_clean_music.answer: a permissively-licensed model (e.g. ACE-Step, MIT) so every track is safe to monetize

deliver_music.hook: The track's done in the studio. What's the final output?
deliver_music.answer: a mastered MP3/WAV ready to publish
